_meta.description: The public gaps ledger: known unknowns and provisional values awaiting verification. Check here before treating an absence in the KB as an oversight. Game questions only.

questions.topic: Melding Construct AR % per rank
questions.detail: The +4%/rank (+20% at rank 5) figure comes from a single item reading. One fully-specced in-game reading validates or corrects it.

questions.topic: Health-Factor mastery interaction with the L60 HP ratio
questions.detail: How +0.2-class Health Factor lines combine with the effective spec ratio (additive to the ratio per dev structure, but magnitude unvalidated at L60).

questions.topic: Combat HP ratio 3.6 unvalidated
questions.detail: Stealth 2.8 validated exact and Magic 2.2 within 1 HP; no Combat-spec L60 measurement on file. Also: Magic 2.2 vs 2.19 rounding.

questions.topic: Piece AR at armor skill above 100
questions.detail: Item-fortified skill scales linearly (verified at 105/118), but one observed character with mastery-raised skill 125 shows a piece reading as if the +25 counts double (250 vs linear 208). Candidate causes: CM-sourced skill points scaling differently, another skill contributing, or an unidentified mechanic. Linear is the well-verified model; tools may underestimate for cap-raised characters until resolved.

questions.topic: Is the Atronach magicka drain live in the current era?
questions.detail: Dev-described drain (5% of max, per the 0.8 doc line 'Damage Magicka on Self') confirmed as a 2023 nerf; current-era status unconfirmed. Stopwatch test: Atronach character, full bar, stand still 60s.

questions.topic: Native health regen
questions.detail: No evidence of any native health regen (vanilla has none); one stopwatch test at partial health settles it.

questions.topic: Unexplained magicka/fatigue surplus on one measured character
questions.detail: One measured L60 Dunmer werewolf character shows a stable 3.85x INT magicka slope (predicted 2.2 for race+sign) and +126 max fatigue over the model — likely one hidden passive package explains both. No matching mastery/racial found in the catalog; werewolf passives on file don't include magicka. Next step: read the character's active-effects Fortify Maximum Magicka lines.

questions.topic: Possible level factor on the 1x INT magicka base
questions.detail: A level-1 character read 0.9x INT naked — below the 1x base. Level factor, or sign/racial detail; needs the character's birthsign and one mid-level reading.

questions.topic: Fatigue level-bonus curve between L1 (+1) and L60 (+55)
questions.detail: One mid-level naked reading pins the curve (candidate: floor(0.9 x level) + 1).

questions.topic: Masteries added after the wiki snapshot
questions.detail: Jan-2026 combat AoE masteries 'Rend' and 'Cleave', a claimed 'Combo Focus 4' (wiki has ranks 1-3), and an unidentified 'Destruction max [75]' mastery are absent from the catalog — stubs exist in masteries.json. Fix: capture /cm in-game or a fresh wiki save.

questions.topic: Do enchant magnitude ceilings scale with anvil-upgraded EV?
questions.detail: If linear, +55 EV on jewelry/clothing would roughly triple ring enchant ceilings. One test enchant on an upgraded blank settles it.

questions.topic: Grand Belt self-enchant baseline
questions.detail: No enchanted belt example observed; inferred ~29 (shirt-class), unverified.

questions.topic: Is the re-equip-during-enchant EV trick still live?
questions.detail: Historically reached 47 pts on a ~20-24 EV ring; possibly patched since.

questions.topic: Terminology: 'CM points' vs the 1500-cap mastery-point pool
questions.detail: Smaller 'CM cap' figures (125/175) appear alongside the 25xlevel pool in community usage; whether these describe one pool or two systems is not explicitly stated anywhere on file.

questions.topic: Rehabilitator Anja refunds vs the free L60 Ergalla respec
questions.detail: Same mechanism, complementary, or one superseded? Both treated as valid until reconciled.

questions.topic: Do purchased birthsign-gated masteries (120 pts) refund on birthsign change?
Boss Sanctuary/crit scaling when event-buffed
questions.detail: One adjacent 2020 claim says world-boss event scaling manifests mainly as resistances.

questions.topic: Emperor Crab resistance drift across patches
questions.detail: Fresh in-game check advised before relying on older resist values.

questions.topic: Focused Strike linear proc model verification
questions.detail: proc% = 0.30 x Agility is an expert player statement adopted as working truth; a one-time in-game count-test would confirm the linear model and the ~334 threshold.

questions.topic: Hit damage formula on NP
questions.detail: best_strike_max x (STR+50)/100 is vanilla-structure, adopted by community tools; not formally validated on NP. Condition/armor-reduction interaction with DISPLAYED AR also unverified.

questions.topic: When/why the planned level cap 100 became 60
questions.detail: Historical curiosity; 60 is definitively current.

questions.topic: Vampire bloodline passive magnitudes
questions.detail: Bloodlines carry substantial passive buffs; magnitudes not yet captured (wiki page pending ingest).

questions.topic: Speed cap 350 vs 175
questions.detail: See contradictions c:speed-cap.

questions.topic: House abandonment rule
questions.detail: See contradictions c:house-abandonment.

questions.topic: Enchanted-item recharge mechanics
questions.detail: See contradictions c:enchant-recharge.

questions.topic: Which vanilla items NP has modified
questions.detail: items.json now carries origin_game (vanilla / np-custom) classified against the actual game ESM rosters. Known so far from tooltip-vs-ESM comparison: NP buffed max damage on several artifacts (e.g. Sunder 60->70, Goldbrand 45->50, Hopesfire 55->70, Eltonbrand 55->60, Skull Crusher 50->60) and changed Mantle of Woe's magicka multiplier (0.5x -> 5.0x INT); Wraithguard/Marara's Ring Reflect 20->10 unverified. Systematically flagging vanilla-modified items is future work.

questions.topic: Weapon speed% to attacks-per-second conversion
questions.detail: The KB stores speed_pct per weapon but has no formula converting it into swing rate, so cross-weapon DPS comparisons (e.g. Keening 250% vs Sunder 150%) are directional only. Resolution: time N swings of two weapons with known speed% at fixed conditions.

questions.topic: Masteries cited by build posts but absent from the wiki capture
questions.detail: 'Champion Master Class' (arch:ascetic-augmenter) and 'Disenchant' (arch:upgrader-enchanter) are claimed in community build posts but have no wiki-captured record — cost/effects/requirements unknown. Stubs added to masteries.json. Resolution: in-game tooltip screenshots or a newer wiki dump.

questions.topic: Rules on stealing from / pickpocketing other players
questions.detail: server_rules.json covers PvP griefing and exploit bans but says nothing about pickpocketing, looting player corpses, or taking from player homes/containers. Unknown whether it is permitted, banned, or mechanically impossible. Resolution: ask staff in Discord and capture the answer with a date.

questions.topic: Recommended level ranges for the elemental tier-1 / event camps
questions.detail: The grind-camp level-range table doesn't cover the elemental atronach camps or event camps (e.g. the 2026 Infernal Flame camp). Only qualitative difficulty signals exist (resist-stack requirements, death reports). Resolution: collect community consensus per camp with dates.

questions.topic: Racial base attributes / skill bonuses
questions.detail: races.json captures the 0.8 rework special abilities only — no base attribute or skill-bonus tables. Unknown whether NP kept vanilla racial base stats or reworked them. Resolution: dev doc check or per-race fresh-character readings.
